blocks.text: HANGS Construction Development LP. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Capitalize an item that costs $5,000.00 or more per unit, including the costs in FA-2, and will be used for more than one year. An item below the threshold is expensed, even when many are bought on one invoice.
An asset's cost is its price and every cost to deliver it and make it ready for use: freight, setup, installation and sales tax.

A repair that keeps an asset in working order, or restores it after a breakdown, is expensed to 6300 Repairs & Maintenance. Only an improvement that extends an asset's life, adds capacity or adapts it to a new use is capitalized.

Depreciate straight-line from the month an asset is placed in service, a full month in that month and through the month it is disposed of, with no salvage value. Lives for assets placed in service from July 1, 2026: heavy equipment 84 months, survey instruments 60 months, site office units 120 months, vehicles 60 months.

When an asset is sold, scrapped or traded in, remove its cost and accumulated depreciation in the month of disposal and record the proceeds. The difference from book value is a gain or loss in 7200 Gain or Loss on Disposal.
The register's cost and accumulated depreciation must equal the general ledger, account by account, after the month's entries.
The Controller reviews the roll-forward and every proposed entry. Entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries.
